newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sweden's deputy foreign minister in Algiers.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's deputy foreign minister in Algiers.

text.p: Swedish deputy Foreign Minister Pierre Schori on Tuesday arrived in Algiers in a two-day visit aimed at boosting cooperation between his country and Algeria, Algerian state-run television said.

"We have a great interest in dialogue with Algeria and to strengthen cooperation with it," he was quoted as saying after his arrival in the Algerian capital where he was met by Lahcen Moussaoui, state secretary for cooperation and Maghreb affairs.
